open_errors.issue: In ch 5 Devan strikes first, openly, at the picket on the cart road, and Kandan sees it ('That was clean'). In ch 8 the narration says he has not struck first at a living man in eight years. What is new in ch 8 is that he kills first.
open_errors.fix: Make the ch 8 claim about killing first, not striking first.

patches.find: He had not struck first at a living man in eight years.
patches.replace: He had not killed a man first in eight years.

open_errors.issue: Kuttu is one of the six who rode to Kodiyur in ch 10, and he is still on the road with Neela in ch 18. In ch 17 Vellan says Kuttu asked him, on the shelf, after the sally, whom he would bind to. In ch 20 Vellan refers back to it as 'the lad'.
open_errors.fix: Have Thulasi, who is on the shelf and beside Vellan, be the one who asked.

open_errors.issue: The household slip 'Say nothing, and your wife is kept' was addressed to Ittan about Ittan's wife (book 2: Muthu carried it to Ittan's cell). Ch 9 has Neela, and then Muthu himself, speak as if a woman of Muthu's is held hostage against his silence.
open_errors.fix: Make Muthu's stake his six-year loyalty to the household, not a hostage.

patches.find: On one side were six years of grey wax and a woman held in a household somewhere.
patches.replace: On one side were six years of grey wax and an oath to a household he had never seen.

patches.find: That wax is dry by now. Somewhere a woman is kept on my silence, and I've just spoken.
patches.replace: That wax is dry by now. Six years that household had my silence, and I've just spoken.

open_errors.issue: Thirty guards are in the count. In ch 15, twenty-two agree and eight refuse. Lata, a refuser, rides north, but the party is still twenty-two guards (28 horses in ch 18; 'Usha, Sanu, Sajan, Lata, and the eighteen' in ch 19). In ch 22 the queen brings only seven guards. That puts 29 guards at Kettamala, yet in ch 24 twenty-six name and four hold back, which is 30. One guard who agreed is never accounted for.
open_errors.fix: Say that one guard who agreed was kept back at the palace and rides in with the queen's column.

patches.find: She had been at the Salt Gate at dusk with a horse and no explanation.
patches.replace: She had been at the Salt Gate at dusk with a horse and no explanation, in the place of a man who had said yes in the shed and been kept back at the palace.

patches.find: Behind them, in a tight knot, rode seven guards in green sashes.
patches.replace: Behind them, in a tight knot, rode eight guards in green sashes.

patches.find: They had been offered their pages and had said no. The eighth who had said no, Lata, was not with them.
patches.replace: Seven had been offered their pages and had said no; the eighth had said yes in the shed and been kept at the palace when the riders went north. The last who had said no, Lata, was not with them.

patches.find: Usha had gone to see to the seven in green.
patches.replace: Usha had gone to see to the eight in green.

open_errors.issue: In ch 16, Neela pricks her thumb only after the water-clock bell, an hour late ('Today she was an hour late'). In ch 19 she tells Devan she pricked a quarter hour late.

patches.find: I pricked a quarter hour late, once she'd gone.
patches.replace: I pricked an hour late, once she'd gone.

open_errors.issue: In ch 1 Neela writes her own name in the plank's last blank, and the plank is then said to have forty-one names. In ch 28 the plank has forty names.

patches.find: Forty names ran down it in her own hand, and nine blanks had been filled since the Resin House.
patches.replace: Forty-one names ran down it in her own hand, and nine blanks had been filled since the Resin House.

open_errors.issue: Thilak is one of Neela's six. In ch 8 the six are described as waiting by the pack pony down the road, but in the same scene Thilak is working the pry-bar beside Devan.
open_errors.fix: Say that Thilak stayed at the bar while the rest of the six waited.

patches.find: Down the road, on the verge where the gorge opened toward the sea, Neela's six stood by a pack pony.
patches.replace: Down the road, on the verge where the gorge opened toward the sea, the rest of Neela's six stood by a pack pony; Thilak had stayed to lend the bar his weight before the road.
